notifyBeaconDeposit(bytes32,uint256).notice: Called by a validator module immediately after pushing ETH to the beacon         deposit contract. Updates the Router's beacon-balance baseline so the         next oracle report does not double-count the principal.

reportModuleBeaconBalance(bytes32,uint25.notice: Called by a validator module after the oracle's sanity-checked report.         Router computes the delta vs. its stored baseline and rebases stToken.

unwrapToModule(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: Called by an LST module to burn stToken shares on LST withdrawal.

wrapFromModule(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: Called by an LST module to mint stToken shares on LST deposit.
